summary: Iteration 3: tested both backend and frontend for private files, the Sending Covenant, admin orders privacy, the report/moderation flow, the guidelines page and the scripture ticker. Backend: 43/43 pytest pass (10 new in test_iteration3_privacy_covenant.py; 2 existing tests updated for private uploads and covenant_accepted). Frontend: all requested flows pass. (1) Personalize: privacy-note and covenant-check are shown, and Buy is disabled until the box is checked. A voice .wav was uploaded and the owner fetch returned 200. A full Stripe 4242 payment reached the success page, which said 'We emailed the card link to delivered@resend.dev'. (2) The anonymous viewer /c/I5ptYaLdZ2A plays the voice from the ?card= URL (currentTime advanced, readyState 4). Without ?card the same file returns 404, and admin gets 404. (3) Report dialog: submit is disabled while the reason is empty; submitting shows a success toast. In Studio the Reports tab lists the report; disable makes /c/:slug show viewer-not-found, and restore brings the card back. (4) Studio Orders shows the privacy note, columns Card/Type/Buyer/Amount/Paid/Status, no links and no recipient data. (5) Builder checkout without the covenant shows an error toast and switches to Message & Media, where the covenant and privacy-note are visible; with the box checked it goes to Stripe. (6) My Cards Checkout shows window.confirm with the covenant text; dismissing it stays on the page. (7) The guidelines page shows all 3 sections, the footer link works, and register-covenant-note includes covenant-link. (8) The ticker appears on every page, moves about 37px/s (animation 1458s), and pauses on hover. hero-motto starts at Matthew 4:19 and changed to the next verse after about 12s.

minor.issue: The db.files record is inserted without a 'public' field, so it is always private. Clipart generated by an admin becomes a library asset (scope=library), but the file returns 404 for every other user and for anonymous visitors in the Builder clip-art panel. It loads only when embedded in a paid card through ?card=. Fix: add "public": user['role'] == 'admin' in the ai_clipart files insert. Existing admin AI files may also need a backfill.

ui_bugs.issue: There is no scroll-to-top on route change. Clicking footer-guidelines-link from the bottom of the landing page opens /guidelines at scrollY≈1459, so the user lands near the end of the page instead of the top. Add a ScrollToTop component (useLocation + window.scrollTo(0,0)).

issues: The panel switches to Message & Media, but the covenant checkbox is at the bottom of the panel and is not scrolled into view. The error toast also partly covers it. Consider scrollIntoView on covenant-check.
The brand 'JESUS CHRIST FISHER OF MEN' wraps onto 4 lines and 'Sign in' wraps to 2 lines, which makes the header cramped. Consider a shorter mobile brand or a smaller font.
'Disable card link' acts immediately with no confirmation (minor).

action_items: Set public=True for admin-generated AI clipart files in POST /api/ai/clipart (and backfill existing ones)
Add scroll-to-top on route change (Guidelines link from the footer opens mid-page)
Optional: scroll the covenant checkbox into view when Builder checkout is blocked
Optional: tidy the mobile header wrapping at 390px
critical_code_review_comments: _can_read_file calls json.dumps on the whole card on every file request through ?card=. This is fine for now; for heavier traffic consider an indexed lookup or caching.
Report endpoint has no per-IP rate limit. The cap of 20 reports per card stops flooding of a single card, but not spam across many cards.
Restoring a card sets all of its reports back to 'open', so reports the admin already reviewed reappear as open. Consider adding a 'reviewed' status.
A disabled card 'P' (slug B6KDHSBGPZ0, $0.00, report 'test report') left by the main agent's curl check is still in the DB.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_velvetnote_api.py (owner fetch for private upload, covenant_accepted on checkout)

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows (1 medium UX bug: no scroll-to-top)

seed_data_creation: Paid card 'Sunshine Get Well' for customer1 (recipient TEST_Iter3, delivered@resend.dev, slug I5ptYaLdZ2A, with a private voice .wav). This can't be deleted because purchased cards are protected. The test report I created and the TEST_iter3_builder draft were deleted. The pytest fixture creates and then deletes its own forced-paid TEST_iter3_private card and reports.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login test ids: auth-email-input/auth-password-input/auth-submit-btn. To upload in Playwright, pass set_input_files with a buffer, because /tmp may be wiped when the container restarts. Voice input: [data-testid=voice-upload-btn-input]. The audio preview is not 'visible' to Playwright, so use state='attached'. In Studio, the report buttons are disable-card-{reportId} and restore-card-{reportId} (they use the report id, not the card id). The Stripe recipe from iteration_2 still works. The pytest file marks a test card as paid through pymongo using MONGO_URL/DB_NAME from backend/.env.
